Server/Classes/Ragdoll.luau.description: Base class for ragdolls, meant to be used with binders. This class exports a [Binder]. While a humanoid is bound with this class, it is ragdolled. Initialize this whole system through [RagdollService]. Public entry points include `Ragdoll.new`.

Server/Classes/RagdollCameraShake.luau.description: Shakes the camera on ragdoll. This class exports a [Binder]. Public entry points include `RagdollCameraShake.new`.

Server/Classes/RagdollHumanoidOnDeath.lu.description: Ragdolls the humanoid on death. This class exports a [Binder]. Public entry points include `RagdollHumanoidOnDeath.new`.

Server/Classes/RagdollHumanoidOnFall.lua.description: When a humanoid is bound with this, it will ragdoll upon falling. Recommended that you use Public entry points include `RagdollHumanoidOnFall.new`, `RagdollHumanoidOnFall.ObserveIsFalling`.

Server/Classes/Ragdollable.luau.description: Should be bound to any humanoid that is ragdollable. This class exports a [Binder]. Public entry points include `Ragdollable.new`, `Ragdollable.ObserveIsRagdolled`, `newRagdollable`.

Server/Classes/UnragdollAutomatically.lu.description: When a humanoid is tagged with this, it will unragdoll automatically. This class exports a [Binder]. Public entry points include `UnragdollAutomatically.new`.

Server/Classes/UnragdollAutomaticallyCon.description: Unragdoll Automatically Constants provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package.

Server/RagdollBindersServer.luau.description: Holds binders for Ragdoll system. Be sure to initialize on the client too. See [RagdollBindersClient]. Be sure to use a [ServiceBag] to initialize this service. Binders can be retrieved directly through a [ServiceBag] now.

Server/RagdollService.luau.description: Initializes ragdoll related binders Public entry points include `RagdollService.Init`, `RagdollService.SetRagdollOnFall`, `RagdollService.SetRagdollOnDeath`, `RagdollService.SetUnragdollAutomatically`.

Server/RagdollUtils.luau.description: Provides a small character-facing facade over Nevermore's Ragdoll binder. Public entry points include `getHumanoid`, `nextTimerToken`, `scheduleUnragdoll`, `RagdollUtils.ragdoll`, `RagdollUtils.unRagdoll`, `RagdollUtils.isRagdolled`.
